task: Write compress_images(paths) that applies a CPU-heavy resize-and-reencode transform (Pillow) to thousands of image files in parallel and returns the output paths. Throughput is the whole point.

constraints.text: CPU-bound fan-out runs on processes: ProcessPoolExecutor or multiprocessing
constraints.why: the GIL capped the 2026-04 thread-based encoder at 1.1x speedup on a 16-core box; switching to a process pool hit 14x

constraints.text: thread pools and raw threading.Thread stay out of the image pipeline
constraints.why: same 2026-04 finding: threads serialized on the GIL and the nightly batch missed its window by five hours

checks.description: uses a thread pool for CPU-bound work
spawns raw threads for CPU-bound work

constraints.text: pool spin-up sits under an if __name__ == '__main__' guard
constraints.why: the spawn start method on the 2026-04 Windows build agent fork-bombed without the guard; the agent needed a hard reboot
